name: Junction
notes: Release build of Junction.app (ad-hoc signed) with its audio driver and routing helper inside, the engine tests and the driver harness, and a self-test that checks the bundled driver loads, the helper is bundled and signed, and the planner, kernel, helper XPC messages and saving work; then copies Junction.app into /Applications/omso.
Installing the driver itself is a separate step in the app (administrator password, restarts Core Audio).
These builds route inside the app (ROUTING_HELPER defaults to 0 without an update feed); nothing is registered with launchd.
